note: Plugin-owned vector table derived from the ALY-257 D-20 scrubber rules. Replace with the API shared file (agent-run-text-vectors.json) when it exists. plugin: exact = the plugin output equals output; safe = the plugin is stricter, forbidden tokens must be absent and plugin_output (when present, null = no text, __drop__ = a text without the survivors) is the plugin result; skip = a documented D-20 rule the plugin does not implement (reason says why). input_gen/output_gen build long strings: prefix + unit repeated times, sliced by code point, plus suffix.
